about: Old Home Distillers is a family farm distillery in Lebanon, Madison County, in the hills southeast of Syracuse. Jerry and Marlene Carvell founded it in 2015 in a converted hundred-year-old stable on historic Campbell Road, and their sons Aaron and Adam help run the stills. The family started with an unaged corn whiskey and has grown, a barrel at a time, into bourbons, rye, single malt, gin and brandy, all made on the farm.

King Mayhem is the top of Old Home’s Mayhem line of straight rye whiskeys, made from 100% New York-grown rye and corn and distilled in copper pot stills. Where the standard Electric Mayhem is bottled at 88 proof, King Mayhem is a rare single barrel selection bottled overproof. “Straight” means it spent at least two years in new charred oak. The distillery last released it in 2022; this is Batch 3. Old Home describes it as intensely spicy, with a cinnamon red-hot snap, and suggests drinking it neat or on the rocks.
